name: Google Tasks
description: Google Tasks provides a simple to-do list and task management system integrated into Gmail and Google Calendar for quick and easy tracking

tools.name: Batch Execute Google Tasks Operations
tools.description: Executes multiple Google Tasks API operations in a single HTTP batch request and returns structured per-item results. Use this to reduce LLM tool invocations when performing bulk operations like updating many tasks, moving tasks, or deleting multiple items. Note: Each sub-request still counts toward API quota; batching primarily reduces HTTP overhead and tool call count.

inputs.name: requests
inputs.about: Array of sub-requests to execute in this batch. Each sub-request is independent and will return its own result.

inputs.name: max_requests
inputs.about: Maximum number of sub-requests allowed in a single batch. Google's typical cap is 1000. Lower values can control response size.

tools.name: Bulk Insert Tasks (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use BatchExecute instead. Creates multiple tasks in a Google Tasks list in a single operation using HTTP batching. Use when you need to create many tasks efficiently (reducing round-trips compared to individual insert calls).

inputs.name: tasks
inputs.about: Array of tasks to create. Each task requires at least a title.

inputs.name: batch_size
inputs.about: Maximum number of tasks per batch request. Default: 50. Tasks exceeding this will be split into multiple batch calls.

inputs.name: tasklist_id
inputs.about: Identifier for the Google Task list where tasks will be created. Use actual task list IDs, not '@default'.

tools.name: Clear tasks
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly clears all completed tasks from a specified Google Tasks list; this action is destructive, idempotent, and cannot be undone. Always require explicit user confirmation before invoking.

inputs.name: tasklist
inputs.about: The identifier of the task list from which to clear completed tasks. Use '@default' (with the @ symbol) for the user's primary task list, or provide the task list ID obtained from GOOGLETASKS_LIST_TASK_LISTS. Note: 'default' without the @ prefix is not valid.

tools.name: Create a task list
tools.description: Creates a new task list with the specified title and returns its details, including its ID for use in task operations. Duplicate titles are permitted, so check existing lists before creating one to avoid unintended duplicates.

inputs.name: tasklist_title
inputs.about: Title for the new task list. The maximum allowed length is 1024 characters.

tools.name: Delete task
tools.description: Deletes a specified task from a Google Tasks list. Deletion is permanent and irreversible — confirm with the user before executing, and consider GOOGLETASKS_UPDATE_TASK or GOOGLETASKS_MOVE_TASK as non-destructive alternatives. Both tasklist_id and task_id are required parameters. The Google Tasks API does not support deleting tasks by task_id alone — you must specify which task list contains the task. Use 'List Task Lists' to get available list IDs, then 'List Tasks' to find the task_id within that list.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Google Task to delete. Required - must be a task that exists within the specified tasklist_id. Obtain this ID by using the 'List Tasks' action with the corresponding tasklist_id. Multiple tasks may share the same title — verify against additional fields (e.g., due date,

inputs.name: tasklist_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Google Task list containing the task to delete. Required - tasks cannot be deleted by task_id alone; the API requires specifying which list contains the task. Obtain this ID by using the 'List Task Lists' action.

tools.name: Delete task list
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing Google Task list, identified by `tasklist_id`, along with all its tasks; this operation is irreversible. Require explicit user confirmation before calling; do not invoke in read-only or exploratory flows.

inputs.name: tasklist_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the Google Task list to be deleted. This field is required and cannot be empty.

tools.name: Get Task
tools.description: Retrieve a specific Google Task. REQUIRES both `tasklist_id` and `task_id`. Tasks cannot be retrieved by ID alone - you must always specify which task list contains the task. Use this to refresh task details before display or edits rather than relying on potentially stale results from GOOGLETASKS_LIST_TASKS.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: REQUIRED. Unique identifier of the Google Task to retrieve. Must be used together with tasklist_id.

inputs.name: tasklist_id
inputs.about: REQUIRED. Unique identifier of the Google Tasks list containing the task. You must always provide this parameter - tasks cannot be retrieved by task_id alone.

tools.name: Get task list
tools.description: Retrieves a specific task list from the user's Google Tasks if the `tasklist_id` exists for the authenticated user.

inputs.name: tasklist_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the task list to retrieve, assigned by Google Tasks when the list is created.

tools.name: List task lists
tools.description: Fetches the authenticated user's task lists from Google Tasks; results may be paginated. Response contains task lists under the `items` key. Multiple lists may share similar names — confirm the correct list by ID before passing to other tools.

inputs.name: pageToken
inputs.about: Token for the page of results to return; omit for the first page, use `nextPageToken` from a previous response for subsequent pages.

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.about: Maximum number of task lists to return per page. Capped at 100; values above 100 are silently truncated to 100.

tools.name: Move Task
tools.description: Moves the specified task to another position in the task list or to a different task list. Use cases: - Reorder tasks within a list (use 'previous' parameter) - Create subtasks by moving a task under a parent (use 'parent' parameter) - Move tasks between different task lists (use 'destinationTasklist' parameter) - Move a subtask back to top-level (omit 'parent' parameter)

inputs.name: task
inputs.about: Task identifier of the task to move. Must be a valid task ID from the source tasklist. Obtain this from 'List Tasks' or 'Insert Task' actions.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: New parent task identifier. If provided, the task becomes a subtask of this parent. The parent must exist in the destination list (or source list if no destinationTasklist is specified). Omit to move task to top level.

inputs.name: previous
inputs.about: New previous sibling task identifier. The task will be positioned immediately after this sibling. Omit to position the task first among its siblings. Must exist in the same list as the task's destination (destinationTasklist if specified, otherwise source tasklist). Cross-list sibling references are

inputs.name: tasklist
inputs.about: Source task list identifier where the task currently exists. Use '@default' for the user's primary task list, or provide a specific task list ID obtained from 'List Task Lists'. The task must exist in this list.

inputs.name: destinationTasklist
inputs.about: Destination task list identifier. If set, the task is moved from the source tasklist to this list. Omit to reorder within the same list. Note: Recurrent tasks cannot be moved between lists.

tools.name: Patch Task
tools.description: Partially updates an existing task (identified by `task_id`) within a specific Google Task list (identified by `tasklist_id`), modifying only the provided attributes from `TaskInput` (e.g., `title`, `notes`, `due` date, `status`) and requiring both the task and list to exist.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Unique identifier for the task. Generated by Google Tasks API when creating a task. Used for updating or deleting existing tasks.

inputs.name: due
inputs.about: Due date for the task (optional). NOTE: Google Tasks only stores the date portion (YYYY-MM-DD) - any time component provided will be automatically stripped before sending to the API. inputs.name: notes
inputs.about: Additional details or description for the task. Supports plain text only (no HTML/markdown). Maximum 8192 characters. Example: 'Include Q3 sales data and projections'

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Title/name of the task. This is the main text displayed for the task. Maximum 1024 characters. Example: 'Complete quarterly report'

inputs.name: hidden
inputs.about: Whether the task is hidden from the default view. Hidden tasks can still be accessed via API but won't show in UI. Default: false

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Current status of the task. Must be either 'needsAction' (task is pending) or 'completed' (task is done).

inputs.name: deleted
inputs.about: Whether the task has been deleted. Deleted tasks are marked but not immediately removed, allowing for recovery. Default: false

inputs.name: task_id

inputs.name: tasklist_id
inputs.about: Identifier of the Google Task list that contains the task to be updated.

tools.description: Updates the title of an existing Google Tasks task list.

inputs.name: tasklist_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the task list to be updated.

inputs.name: updated_title
inputs.about: The new title for the task list. Optional for PATCH semantics - only include if you want to update the title. Maximum length: 1024 characters.

tools.name: Update Task (Full Replacement)
tools.description: Tool to fully replace an existing Google Task using PUT method. Use when you need to update the entire task resource, not just specific fields. This method requires all required fields (id, title) and replaces the complete task, unlike PATCH which supports partial updates.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Task identifier (REQUIRED). Must match the task_id parameter. This field is required by the Google Tasks API for PUT operations.

inputs.name: due
inputs.about: Due date for the task. NOTE: Google Tasks only stores the date portion (YYYY-MM-DD). Accepts RFC3339 format (e.g., '2025-09-28T00:00:00Z') or date strings like '2025-09-28'.

inputs.name: etag
inputs.about: ETag of the resource for concurrency control. Prevents accidental overwrites when multiple clients modify the same task.

inputs.name: links
inputs.about: Collection of links attached to the task. This collection is read-only.

inputs.name: notes
inputs.about: Additional details or description for the task. Supports plain text only. Maximum 8192 characters.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Title/name of the task (REQUIRED). This is the main text displayed for the task. Maximum 1024 characters.

inputs.name: hidden
inputs.about: Whether the task is hidden. This is read-only and set by the API when task list is cleared. Default: false

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: Parent task identifier for subtasks. This field is read-only. Use the 'move' method to change parent.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Current status of the task. Must be either 'needsAction' (task is pending) or 'completed' (task is done).

inputs.name: deleted
inputs.about: Whether the task has been deleted. Deleted tasks are marked but not immediately removed. Default: false

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: Identifier of the Google Task to be fully replaced within the specified task list. This must also be included in the 'id' field of the request body.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Position of the task among siblings. This field is read-only. Use the 'move' method to change position.

inputs.name: completed
inputs.about: Date/time when the task was marked as completed. Only applicable when status='completed'. Unlike 'due', this field preserves the time component. Accepts RFC3339 format.

inputs.name: tasklist_id
inputs.about: Identifier of the Google Task list that contains the task to be updated.
